aiDescription: Adds a small collection of kitbashed ships derived from the Apogee design. Includes a frigate with high speed and strong shields, a logistical support vessel, a combat-capable ship with limited combat ability, and a cruiser with surprising offensive power. Ships are designed for varied roles in fleet composition.
